summary: עשר describes wealth and becoming rich. Yahweh can enrich the land and people, while scripture warns that riches do not secure life or righteousness.

senses.definition: Riches are material abundance, contrasted with poverty and judged by whether they are gained justly.
A rich person is one who possesses wealth, yet rich and poor alike are made by Yahweh.
Yahweh enriches the earth and its grain.
A person may become rich, but wealth does not make a person secure.
One may claim to be rich while possessing nothing.
